program:
app "Carrom tournament" trophy plum
table point team pick Pair_A|Pair_B, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Pair_A)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Pair_B)
setting winat num = 29 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Pair A" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Pair_A, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Pair_A, pts = 2
      button "+3" tap add point team = Pair_A, pts = 3
  stack card grow align center
    "Pair B" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Pair_B, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Pair_B, pts = 2
      button "+3" tap add point team = Pair_B, pts = 3
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
if a >= winat
  "Pair A win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Pair B win!" head color good
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
list point
describe:
Carrom tournament, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Pair A, Pair B; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Play to": number, starts at 29.
Works out:
- a is the total pts of point where team is Pair A.
- b is the total pts of point where team is Pair B.
Shows:
- text: "Pair A".
- text: a.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Pair A, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Pair A, pts set to 2.
- a button "+3"; a tap adds a point with team set to Pair A, pts set to 3.
- text: "Pair B".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Pair B, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Pair B, pts set to 2.
- a button "+3"; a tap adds a point with team set to Pair B, pts set to 3.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- if a is at least winat:
  - text: "Pair A win!".
- if b is at least winat:
  - text: "Pair B win!".
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.
- a list of point; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: terse like a search query, 2 to 6 words
fuller_style: one sentence of 14 to 22 words, mentions the most special feature first
order: start with the numbers or units

program:
app "Car checklist" car plum
table car_task title text, done bool, priority pick Low|Normal|High = Normal, due date?
count(car_task where done = no) "open" head
each car_task where done = no sort priority desc as t
  row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
    toggle t.done
    stack grow
      t.title bold
      t.due small color if(t.due < today, bad, muted)
form car_task
"Done" faint
list car_task where done = yes
button "Clear done" tap remove all car_task where done = yes
describe:
Car checklist, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- car task: title: text; done: yes or no; priority: one of Low, Normal, High, starts at Normal; due: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: how many car task entries where done is no, "open".
- for each car task where done is no sorted by priority, highest first:
  - a group; a tap opens the car task for editing; a swipe removes the car task, with undo:
    - a tick box for the done of the car task.
    - text: the title of the car task.
    - text: the due of the car task.
- a form to add a car task.
- text: "Done".
- a list of car task where done is yes; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
- a button "Clear done"; a tap removes all car task entries where done is yes, with one undo.

program:
app "Mobile shop" phone plum
table accessory name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 10, price money?, kind pick Home|Work|Other, expires date?
state q text = ""
let short = count(accessory, it.qty <= it.low)
short "accessories running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each accessory where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
      "Expires" i.expires faint color if(i.expires < today, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(accessory, it.qty * it.price) faint
form accessory
remind "Check your accessories" at 9:00 on sat
describe:
Mobile shop, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- accessory: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 10; price: money, optional; kind: one of Home, Work, Other; expires: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the accessory have its qty is at most its low.
Remembers while you use it: q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: short, "accessories running low".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search".
- for each accessory where name contains q sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the accessory for editing; a swipe removes the accessory, with undo:
    - text: the name of the accessory.
    - text: the kind of the accessory.
    - text: "Expires", the expires of the accessory.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the accessory to the qty of the accessory minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the accessory.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the accessory to the qty of the accessory plus 1.
- text: "Stock value", the sum of its qty times its price over the accessory.
- a form to add a accessory.
Reminder "Check your accessories" at 9:00 on Sat.
hurried_style: a single sentence of 6 to 12 words, casual
fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words
order: start with the most unusual feature

program:
app "Shared flat" home ocean
table flatmate name text
table flat_entry flatmate ref flatmate, amount money, kind pick Paid_for|Paid_back, note text?
"Flat balance" sum(flat_entry.amount where kind = Paid_for) - sum(flat_entry.amount where kind = Paid_back) big
each flatmate as p
  let bal = sum(p.flat_entry.amount where kind = Paid_for) - sum(p.flat_entry.amount where kind = Paid_back)
  stack card tap edit p
    row
      p.name bold grow
      if(bal >= 0, "owes you", "you owe") abs(bal) color if(bal >= 0, good, bad)
form flatmate, "Add flatmate"
form flat_entry, "Add entry"
list flat_entry by day
describe:
Shared flat, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- flatmate: name: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- flat entry: flatmate: a flatmate; amount: money; kind: one of Paid for, Paid back; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: "Flat balance", the total amount of flat entry where kind is Paid for minus the total amount of flat entry where kind is Paid back.
- for each flatmate:
  - a group; a tap opens the flatmate for editing:
    - text: the name of the flatmate.
    - text: "owes you" when bal is at least 0, otherwise "you owe", bal without its sign.
- a form to add a flatmate.
- a form to add a flat entry.
- a list of flat entry by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
